# CTRA.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp615.0 against Rp500.0 (expected total return 30.2%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: property_nav_discount_narrowing · method card: per fund record routing for Property developers.
